zh: 圆滚滚地游来，像海里落下一颗豆子。
en: Round and plump, like a little bean that fell into the sea.

zh: 拖着飘飘的尾巴，把海风也系成了蝴蝶结。
en: Its trailing tail could tie the sea breeze into a bow.

zh: 让海水透过身体，像一小块会游泳的窗。
en: Seawater shines through its body: a little window that swims.

zh: 鼓着铃铛一样的身体，轻轻晃过水面。
en: A little bell-shaped body swaying gently through the water.

zh: 云朵偶尔也想在海里住一会儿。
en: Sometimes even a cloud wants to live in the sea.

zh: 把一点暖光揣在身上，慢悠悠地游。
en: It carries a little warm light wherever it wanders.

zh: 星星没有落到底，它长出了尾巴。
en: This star never sank. It grew a tail instead.

zh: 也许正在做梦，顺着浪花漂到了这里。
en: Perhaps it was dreaming when the waves brought it here.

zh: 细细长长，像一根在海里游的面条。
en: Long and slender, like a noodle swimming in the sea.

zh: 柔软的长身子在水里蜿蜒。
en: Its supple body winds gently through the water.

zh: 圆圆的身体后面飘着长尾巴。
en: A round little body with a long tail fluttering behind.
A long silver fish that swims through the night.

zh: 第一次钓到这种模样，记在小本子上了。
en: A new shape of fish! I have put it in my little book.

zh: 这一页有新朋友了，真好。
en: A new friend on this page. How lovely.

zh: 又遇见一种特别的模样，想把它记下来。
en: Another special little shape. I want to remember this one.
